insight: Founded in 2022 by Ukrainian engineers; early angel backing came from Daniel Gross and Google for Startups.
name: Bluedot
tagline: Bot-free AI notetaker that records and summarizes meetings.
description: Bluedot captures, transcribes, and summarizes online and in-person meetings without sending a bot into the call — recording happens through the browser extension or desktop app instead. It generates use-case-tailored notes and can push summaries to your CRM, Notion, and other tools. Works across Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, and live conversations.
edge: Records Zoom, Meet, and Teams calls without sending a bot into the meeting — capture happens via the browser or desktop, not a visible participant.
pros: No bot joins the call — less intrusive
Works on Zoom, Meet, Teams, and in person
Auto-syncs notes to CRM and Notion
Free tier to try it out
cons: Free plan capped at 5 lifetime meetings
Capture is tied to your browser/device
